GAMEPLAY_BoredDescription.English: Why does nothing interesting ever happen around here ?
GAMEPLAY_BoredDescription.French (France): Pourquoi rien d'intéressant ne se passe jamais par ici ?
GAMEPLAY_BoredDescription.Spanish (Spain): ¿Por qué nunca pasa nada interesante por aquí ?
GAMEPLAY_BoredDescription.German: Warum passiert hier nie etwas Interessantes ?
GAMEPLAY_BoredDescription.Turkish: Burada neden hiç ilginç bir şey olmuyor ?
GAMEPLAY_BoredDescription.Russian: Почему здесь никогда не происходит ничего интересного ?

GAMEPLAY_VeryBoredDescription.English: Can barely take it anymore. Isn't there ANYTHING fun to do ?
GAMEPLAY_VeryBoredDescription.French (France): Tu n'en peux plus. Il n'y a vraiment RIEN d'amusant à faire ?
GAMEPLAY_VeryBoredDescription.Spanish (Spain): Ya casi no aguanto más. ¿No hay nada divertido que hacer ?
GAMEPLAY_VeryBoredDescription.German: Ich halte es kaum noch aus. Gibt es denn gar nichts mehr, was Spaß macht ?
GAMEPLAY_VeryBoredDescription.Turkish: Artık dayanamıyorum. Yapacak eğlenceli bir şey yok mu ?
GAMEPLAY_VeryBoredDescription.Russian: Я уже еле выдержала. Неужели нечем заняться ?

GAMEPLAY_ExBoredDescription.English: They never said the end of the world would be like this...
GAMEPLAY_ExBoredDescription.French (France): Ils n'ont jamais dit que la fin du monde serait comme ça...
GAMEPLAY_ExBoredDescription.Spanish (Spain): Nunca dijeron que el fin del mundo sería así...
GAMEPLAY_ExBoredDescription.German: Niemand hat gesagt, dass das Ende der Welt so aussehen würde...
GAMEPLAY_ExBoredDescription.Turkish: Dünyanın sonunun böyle olacağını hiç söylemediler...
GAMEPLAY_ExBoredDescription.Russian: Никто не говорил, что конец света будет именно таким...

GAMEPLAY_SadDescription.English: Having a hard time lately. Seek some way to forget your troubles.
GAMEPLAY_SadDescription.French (France): Tu traverse une période difficile. Essaie de trouver un moyen d'oublier tes soucis.
GAMEPLAY_SadDescription.Spanish (Spain): Lo estoy pasando mal últimamente. Busca una manera de olvidar tus problemas.
GAMEPLAY_SadDescription.German: Ich habe es in letzter Zeit schwer. Suche nach einer Möglichkeit, meine Sorgen zu vergessen.
GAMEPLAY_SadDescription.Turkish: Son zamanlarda zor zamanlar geçiriyorsunuz. Sorunlarınızı unutmanın bir yolunu bulun.
GAMEPLAY_SadDescription.Russian: В последнее время переживаю трудные времена. Найдите способ забыть о своих проблемах.

GAMEPLAY_WeepyDescription.English: You always feel on the verge of tears. Nothing seems to go your way.
GAMEPLAY_WeepyDescription.French (France): Tu as toujours l'impression d'être au bord des larmes. Rien ne semble aller dans ton sens.
GAMEPLAY_WeepyDescription.Spanish (Spain): Siempre estás al borde de las lágrimas. Nada parece salirte bien.
GAMEPLAY_WeepyDescription.German: Du stehst ständig kurz vor den Tränen. Nichts scheint so zu laufen, wie du es dir wünschst.
GAMEPLAY_WeepyDescription.Turkish: Sürekli ağlamak üzereymiş gibi hissediyorsun. Hiçbir şey yolunda gitmiyor gibi.
GAMEPLAY_WeepyDescription.Russian: Ты постоянно чувствуешь, что вот-вот расплачешься. Кажется, ничего не получается.

GAMEPLAY_MiserableDescription.English: Ravaged by mourning and desperation. You're losing hope...
GAMEPLAY_MiserableDescription.French (France): Ravagé par le deuil et le désespoir. Tu perds espoir...
GAMEPLAY_MiserableDescription.Spanish (Spain): Devastado por el duelo y la desesperación. Estás perdiendo la esperanza...
GAMEPLAY_MiserableDescription.German: Von Trauer und Verzweiflung gezeichnet. Du verlierst die Hoffnung...
GAMEPLAY_MiserableDescription.Turkish: Yas ve umutsuzlukla harap olmuşsun. Umudunu kaybediyorsun...
GAMEPLAY_MiserableDescription.Russian: Измученный горем и отчаянием. Ты теряешь надежду...

GAMEPLAY_HopelessDescription.English: What's the point in going on ? Nothing good will ever happen...
GAMEPLAY_HopelessDescription.French (France): À quoi bon continuer ? Rien de bon n'arrivera jamais...
GAMEPLAY_HopelessDescription.Spanish (Spain): ¿Qué sentido tiene seguir así? Nada bueno pasará jamás...
GAMEPLAY_HopelessDescription.German: Wozu soll das Ganze noch weitergehen? Es wird sowieso nichts Gutes dabei herauskommen...
GAMEPLAY_HopelessDescription.Turkish: Devam etmenin ne anlamı var? Hiçbir iyi şey olmayacak...
GAMEPLAY_HopelessDescription.Russian: Какой смысл продолжать? Ничего хорошего из этого не выйдет...
